definitions.explanation: The activity of flying a kite, traditionally associated with the New Year in Japan.

examples.japanese: お{正月|しょうがつ}に{凧揚|たこあ}げをした。
examples.english: I flew kites at New Year's.

examples.japanese: {河川敷|かせんしき}は{凧揚|たこあ}げに{最適|さいてき}な{場所|ばしょ}だ。
examples.english: The riverbank is an ideal place for kite flying.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちと{一緒|いっしょ}に{凧揚|たこあ}げを{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: I enjoyed flying kites together with the children.

notes:
CULTURAL CONTEXT: {凧揚|たこあ}げ is one of the traditional New Year (お{正月|しょうがつ}) activities in Japan, along with {羽根|はね}つき (Japanese badminton), {福笑|ふくわら}い (pin-the-face game), and {独楽回|こままわ}し (top spinning).

TRADITIONAL KITES:
- {和凧|わだこ}: traditional Japanese kite
- {連凧|れんだこ}: train of connected kites
- {奴凧|やっこだこ}: kite shaped like a servant figure

SEASONAL ASSOCIATION:
- Most strongly associated with New Year
- Also enjoyed in spring when winds are favorable
- Some regions have kite festivals ({凧揚|たこあ}げ{大会|たいかい})

RELATED WORDS:
- {凧|たこ}: kite
- {凧糸|たこいと}: kite string
- {凧|たこ}を{揚|あ}げる: to fly a kite
